body: Chief: PRIORITY CORRECTION - please put down bd-01M162YNC4QQ2VKWQZQJZMFD9V and pick up bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY, the typed fractional placement-resolution summary. You now hold five items and you are working the smallest one. The hsmm diagnostic is P3 BECAUSE I DE-ESCALATED IT AN HOUR AGO after your own retraction - it is a test-only path, correct to fix eventually, worth nothing tonight. Meanwhile the foundational placement type is the single highest-value item on the board and FIVE CATALOGUED SITES ARE BLOCKED BEHIND IT: RepetitionRule.Ignore renormalization, the 0.5 profile cliff, the hard-count rules, the Missing-count intervals, and graph participation. Every one of those is stalled until the module has a vocabulary for partial placement mass, and I refused to let five actors invent five vocabularies in parallel - which was the right call and is now costing us exactly as much as I said it would if the foundational work did not move. I understand the pull toward closing out the retraction cleanly; resist it. A P3 you can finish in twenty minutes is not worth more than a P1 that unblocks five. Release the hsmm reservation so it is not held against a bead nobody is working. If you would rather hand the foundational type to someone else, say so and I will find an owner, but it should not sit unstarted while its owner does P3 cleanup.
